current_golden_path.learner_outcome: A first-time invited learner understands the whole five-map journey, recognizes Exploration Camp as the current starting map, and independently reaches the first required learning material with a clear desire to continue.

machine_acceptance.criterion: Each actionable screen exposes exactly one truthful primary action and no competing learner entry.
The path works without horizontal overflow or hidden primary actions at 390, 768, and 1280 CSS pixels.
The learner reaches approved required material before any task asks for an output.
Keyboard, touch, reduced motion, loading, error, and re-entry states preserve a clear next action without console errors.

human_acceptance.criterion: Without facilitator explanation, first-time learners can state that Muchen Journey contains five maps, that they are starting in Exploration Camp, and what to do next within 10 seconds.
Without facilitator explanation, first-time learners independently open the first required learning material within 60 seconds.
Learners rate both progress clarity and willingness to continue to the next station.
No facilitator explains the entry, route, terminology, or next action during the measured path.

current_golden_path.stop_rule: A READY_FOR_HUMAN candidate is frozen and cannot be promoted or released without valid human evidence. Other map workstreams may continue only within isolated, non-dependent boundaries while the program controller preserves this candidate.

maps.name: 探索营
maps.mission: 建立旅程方向感、成长意图和第一份可核对的能力基线。

maps.name: 新手村
maps.mission: 完成公司、岗位、协作方式与基本工作习惯的真实融入。

maps.name: AI学院
maps.mission: 通过课程、练习与测评形成可解释的 AI 能力成长记录。

maps.name: 交付线工会
maps.mission: 在真实交付协作中积累项目证据、反馈、复盘与导师评价。

maps.name: 认证竞技场
maps.mission: 通过固定挑战、真人 Panel 与独立申诉形成可复核的综合能力认证。
maps.purpose: 证据约束的综合能力认证
